page.overview:
What is Kriss?

This weapon is used by Ashrah in Mortal Kombat: Deception, Unchained, Armageddon and Mortal Kombat 1.

Ashrah believes that the Kris is blessed and by slaying demons, Ashrah would become more humane and would be able to leave the Netherrealm. Although, Nitara and her vampire race consider this to be a curse, where it corrupts the wielder into thinking they were using it for a greater purpose.

It has been revealed that the blade Ashrah wields is a sinister creation known to the vampires as Datusha. It had slain many vampires in the past.

In Armageddon, Kreate a Fighters can select Kriss as a weapon if the Swords weapon type is selected.
